question: How to start playing Dinosaur Game and what are the basic controls?
answer: To start playing Dinosaur Game, simply press the spacebar or the up arrow key when the game is in focus. The basic controls include pressing the spacebar or up arrow to make the dinosaur jump, and the down arrow to make it duck. For example, when a cactus appears, press the spacebar to jump over it. This simple mechanic is the foundation of the game.
